steps.title: Find your fit
steps.body: Twelve sizes in every box. Match each nail dry before a drop of glue goes anywhere.

steps.title: Press and hold
steps.body: Cuticle first, then roll the nail down flat. Ten seconds of pressure is the whole technique.

steps.title: Wear, then keep
steps.body: Two to three weeks on. Lift them gently with oil and the set goes back in the box for next time.
